technical.summary: MET shows bullish structure with price above key moving averages and positive momentum indicators, but overbought conditions (stoch, Williams %R, StochRSI) and weak trend strength (ADX 15) limit conviction for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: MET shows no fundamental momentum with zero insider activity, no institutional signal, absent government contracts, no lobbying presence, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 16 days creating near-term uncertainty.

sentiment.congressional_conviction: medium — moderate amounts, junior-to-mid tier members
sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (23/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but recent congressional activity shows net selling pressure with no offsetting institutional conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (333.4) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinationals, and earnings binary event in 16 days compounds risk for financial sector.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above 200-EMA with supertrend bullish and AO cross-up provides technical structure; extreme fear (23/100) and contrarian sentiment offer asymmetric risk/reward if macro stabilizes.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought oscillators (stoch, Williams %R, StochRSI), weak ADX (15), earnings binary in 16 days, inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels, and zero fundamental/insider conviction create unacceptable risk-to-reward for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical structure (price above 200-EMA, supertrend bullish) offers moderate setup, but overbought oscillators and weak ADX (15) signal poor entry timing with unfavorable risk-to-reward.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings binary event in 16 days combined with inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels, and zero fundamental conviction create unacceptable downside exposure for swing trade.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding MET position with 12 existing Financials exposures; macro environment (inverted curve, VIX 333.4) argues against adding concentration in sector during crisis conditions.
